senses.gloss:
हृष् हृष् (originally भृष्), cl. 4. 1. P.
हृष्यति, हर्षति (ep. also A. -ते), ज-
हर्ष, हर्षिष्यति, अहृषत्, अहर्षीत्, हर्-
षितुम्, to bristle or become erect (as the hair of
the body); to thrill with rapture, rejoice, exult, be
glad or pleased; to become erect (said of other things
besides the hair); (according to some, also) to speak
or affirm falsely, lie (but in this sense only P.): Pass.
हृष्यते, Aor. अहर्षि: Caus. हर्षयति, -यि-
तुम्, Aor. अजहर्षत् or अजीहृषत्, to make glad,
cause to rejoice; to be glad, rejoice: Desid. जिहर्-
षिषति: Intens. जरीहृष्यते, जर्हर्ष्टि, &c.,
to rejoice very much, be exceedingly elated; [cf. Gr.
φρίσσω, φρίξ, (perhaps also) χέρσος, χήρ; Lat.
horreo, Hersilia; Old Germ. burst; Angl. Sax.
byrst, bristl, forst, frost, frysan, a-grisan, gerst,
gryre.]

हृषि, (probably) rejoicing; (ई), m. du. Agni
and Soma, (according to Śabda-k. = अग्नी-सोमौ.)
—हृषी-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, Ved. full of joy, glad,
happy, (Sāy. = प्राप्त-हर्ष, Ṛg-veda II. 31, 1.)

हृषित, अस्, आ, अम्, having the hair bristling or
thrilling (with joy &c.); enraptured, delighted,
pleased; astonished, surprised; erect, fresh (as flowers,
opposed to म्लान); disappointed, deceived; bent,
bowed (= प्र-णत); armed, accoutred (= वर्-
मित).
—हृषित-स्रज्, क्, क्, क्, having a fresh gar-
land (the flowers of which are erect and unfaded).

हृषीक, अम्, n. any organ of sense (= इन्द्रिय).
—हृषीकेश (˚क-ईश), अस्, m. ‘lord of the organs
of sense,’ Viṣṇu or Kṛṣṇa.
—हृषीकेश-तीर्थ,
अम्, n., N. of a Tīrtha.

हृष्ट, अस्, आ, अम् [cf. हृषित], having the
hair of the body bristling or thrilling (with delight
or rapture), enraptured, delighted, rejoiced, pleased,
glad, joyous, delighted; exulting, laughing, smiling;
astonished, surprised; disappointed, deceived (=
प्रति-हत).
—हृष्ट-चित्त, अस्, आ, अम्, rejoiced
in heart.
—हृष्ट-पुष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, merry and
fat, happy and well-fed.
—हृष्ट-पुष्टाङ्ग (˚ट-
अङ्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, merry and fat in limb, happy and
well nourished, frisky and fat.
—हृष्ट-मानस,
अस्, ई, अम्, rejoiced in mind, glad in heart, happy.
—हृष्ट-रूप, अस्, आ, अम्, thrilling with happi-
ness, in a happy or cheerful mood.
—हृष्ट-रोमन्,
आ, आ, अ, having the hair of the body bristling or
thrilling (with delight or rapture).
—हृष्ट-वत्,
ind. cheerfully.
—हृष्ट-वदन, अस्, आ, अम्,
merry-faced, having a cheerful countenance.
—हृ-
ष्ट-सङ्कल्प, अस्, आ, अम्, pleased in mind, con-
tented, glad.
—हृष्ट-हृदय, अस्, आ, अम्, joyous-
hearted, light-hearted, happy.

हृष्टि, इस्, f. delight, pleasure, joy, happiness;
pride, arrogance.
हृष्ट्वा, ind. having rejoiced, being delighted.
